emu-compat-slot.name: EmuCompat
emu-compat-slot.description: Looks up PlayStation 2, 3 and 4 title IDs and PC game names: emulator compatibility (PCSX2, RPCS3, ShadPS4), the latest PS3 patch version, Steam and ProtonDB details and SteamGridDB cover art.

showCover.label: Show cover art
showCover.description: Show the game's cover art from SteamGridDB. Requires an API key.

steamGridDbApiKey.label: SteamGridDB API key
steamGridDbApiKey.description: Required for cover art. Cover art stays disabled while this is empty.

showDescription.label: Show Wikipedia description
showDescription.description: Show the short Wikipedia summary for the title.

showDetails.label: Show details
showDetails.description: List the detail rows (compatibility, version) below the title.

showCompatibility.label: Show RPCS3 / ShadPS4 compatibility
showCompatibility.description: Look up PS3 titles in the RPCS3 database and PS4 titles in the ShadPS4 database.

showCompat.label: Show PCSX2 compatibility
showCompat.description: Show the PCSX2 compatibility rating for PS2 titles.

showVersion.label: Show version
showVersion.description: Show the latest PS3 update version. Sony's update server is only contacted while this is on.

showRegion.label: Show region badge
showRegion.description: Show the release region (US, EU, JP, ...) next to the title ID.

pcPlainSearch.label: PC games on plain searches
pcPlainSearch.description: Show a PC game card when a search is exactly a popular Steam game's name. Every such search asks Steam; turn off to keep plain searches local.

pcLooseMatches.label: Similar names on plain searches
pcLooseMatches.description: Also show popular games whose name only starts with or shares words with the search ("dark souls" → Dark Souls III). Off: the exact name only.

pcMinReviews.label: Minimum Steam reviews
pcMinReviews.description: A plain search only shows games with at least this many Steam reviews.

browserLanguage.label: Use browser language
browserLanguage.description: Show descriptions in the visitor's browser language when available (Steam's for PC games, Wikipedia's for PlayStation games), and the card's own text in degoog's language. Off: everything in English.

nameSearch.heading: Matching title IDs
nameSearch.hint: Use a title ID with the same command to see its details.
nameSearch.usage: Type a game name or a title ID after the command, for example
nameSearch.narrow: Add pc, ps2, ps3 or ps4 to search a single platform, for example

emu-compat-command.name: Game Lookup
emu-compat-command.description: Search PC, PS2, PS3 and PS4 games by name or title ID. Add pc, ps2, ps3 or ps4 to narrow it down.
